message.content:
{
  "maturity": "initial",
  "focalEvent": {
    "label": "Instrument-air pressure dropped at RHOB receiving header (P-R) from ~6.8 bar to below 4.1 bar, triggering alarm AL-44 and pausing work.",
    "detail": "At approximately 10:00 AM on May 20, 2024, the RHOB process area reported loss of instrument-air pressure while a two-person Utilities team was preparing the #1 slab caster (1SC) compressor/dryer system for planned maintenance. The work was paused and air supply restored by ~10:07 AM.",
    "status": "supported",
    "sourceIds": [
      "incident-description"
    ],
    "specialistIds": []
  },
  "nodes": [
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Upstream pressure P-U remained stable at ~6.9 bar during the event.",
      "detail": "Pressure readings show no drop upstream of the distribution routes, indicating a localized issue downstream or within RHOB path rather than source failure.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Local indication P-R normally shows normal pressure band in RHOB service station.",
      "detail": "The area directory defines the receiving header H-R and indication P-R as part of the RHOB operations scope, with a defined 'normal record custodian'.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Area directory is a location index and does not establish valve positions or pressure availability at any given time.",
      "detail": "The document explicitly states it is an index, not a current piping diagram. It cannot confirm whether valves were open/closed during the event.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Work package WO-527-E field execution record was blank at folder issue.",
      "detail": "The work-package cover explicitly states the field execution record (WO-527-E) was blank when issued, meaning no initial valve-by-valve status or isolation checklist was recorded before the event.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Crew U-A/U-B held current operating qualifications and energy-control authorization at shift start.",
      "detail": "Assignment extract confirms both crew members had valid Utilities operating qualification and energy-control authorization recorded for the shift.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Shift log records 'boundary preparation in progress' but does not identify point of interruption or valve states.",
      "detail": "The shift log entry at 09:48 notes boundary preparation was underway, yet provides no detail on which valves were open/closed or where the pressure drop originated.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Alarm AL-44 mapped to P-R pressure, not compressor status; 'COMP FAULT' label is a legacy display artifact.",
      "detail": "Point register confirms AL-44 maps to RHOB PLC low-pressure input from P-R. The alarm text retained an older template label unrelated to the actual trip contact C-11.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Pressure drop occurred only at P-R (RHOB receiving header) while upstream P-U remained normal (~6.9 bar), indicating a localized issue downstream of the North gallery or within the RHOB distribution path.",
      "detail": "Numeric samples show pressure dropping from 6.8 to below 4.1 bar at P-R, with no corresponding drop in P-U readings, supporting a localized failure rather than upstream source loss.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "The specific communication medium (radio, phone, face-to-face) is not explicitly stated in the provided evidence.",
      "detail": "No record specifies how RHOB communicated with Utilities; this gap limits understanding of response latency or potential miscommunication risks.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "story-release:323756f5-dbe1-4650-9121-d583b3f97d77:bq-1fanm2w"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Environmental conditions such as noise or distance affecting message clarity are not documented in the provided evidence.",
      "detail": "No documentation exists regarding ambient noise, distance between teams, or other environmental factors that could have impacted communication reliability during the event.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "story-release:323756f5-dbe1-4650-9121-d583b3f97d77:bq-1fanm2w"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "The alarm's occurrence time, acknowledgment time and export time may differ.",
      "detail": "Record conventions state these times can vary; the 10:00 AM indication does not necessarily reflect when Utilities acknowledged or responded to the issue.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "d838e866-dc34-4814-8dad-3b97d0353f05#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "An empty form field records no value; the reason it is empty requires other evidence.",
      "detail": "The blank WO-527-E record indicates missing data, but does not inherently prove negligence or procedural failure without further context on why fields were left unfilled.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "d838e866-dc34-4814-8dad-3b97d0353f05#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Maintenance acceptance signature was not yet signed at notification time.",
      "detail": "The work-package cover notes the maintenance acceptance signature field was unsigned, indicating boundary release had not been formally completed when the alarm occurred.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "The training extract does not state which configuration drawing the crew saw or whether either person received a recent change briefing.",
      "detail": "No record confirms if U-A/U-B reviewed updated drawings or briefings related to valve states, isolation procedures, or system changes prior to starting work.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "No interview concerning fatigue, workload or individual intent is included in this extract.",
      "detail": "Absence of interviews precludes assessment of human factors such as stress, distraction, or decision-making context during the event window.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "The desk entries do not log every field operation.",
      "detail": "Shift logs omit granular operational details, limiting ability to reconstruct exact sequence of actions leading up to the pressure drop.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "'Normal band' is the operator's entry, not a captured numeric measurement.",
      "detail": "Operator entries describing 'normal band' are subjective assessments rather than instrumented data points; they cannot confirm actual pressure values without supporting records.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    }
  ],
  "questions": [
    {
      "intent": "Identify the specific valve or component that failed and caused the localized pressure drop at P-R.",
      "text": "What physical mechanism (e.g., stuck-open valve, ruptured line, faulty regulator) caused the pressure loss between ~10:00 AM and 10:03 AM? Which drawing, inspection record, or maintenance history could confirm this?",
      "rationale": "Without knowing the exact failure point, corrective actions may target the wrong system component. Evidence gaps include lack of valve state logs, flow data, or physical damage reports.",
      "evidenceNeeded": [
        "Valve position records for RHOB distribution path",
        "Maintenance history for P-R sensor/regulator assembly",
        "Physical inspection report post-event"
      ],
      "priority": "high","sourceIds":[],
      "routedTo":["equipment-tool"]}, {
      "intent": "Determine whether the blank WO-527-E field execution record contributed to the event by omitting critical isolation steps.",
      "text": "Did the absence of a completed field execution record (WO-527-E) mean that required valve closures or checks were not performed? What procedure mandates completion before work begins?",
      "rationale": "If procedural non-compliance is confirmed, it becomes a root cause candidate. However, we must first establish whether any documented requirement explicitly demanded this field be filled prior to starting.",
      "evidenceNeeded": [
        "Work package instructions for WO-527",
        "Procedure requiring completion of execution record before work start"
      ],
      "priority": "medium","sourceIds":[],
      "routedTo":["human"]}, {
      "intent": "Clarify whether the unsigned maintenance acceptance signature indicates incomplete boundary release.",
      "text": "Was formal boundary release required by procedure before starting work? If so, did U-A/U-B proceed without it?",
      "rationale": "Unsigned signatures may indicate procedural gaps but do not automatically prove unauthorized action unless a requirement exists and was violated. Need to verify if 'maintenance released' status is mandatory.",
      "evidenceNeeded": [
        "Boundary release procedure document",
        "Work authorization form template"
      ],
      "priority": "medium","sourceIds":[],
      "routedTo":["human"]}, {
      "intent": "Assess whether communication gaps contributed to delayed response or miscoordination.",
      "text": "How did RHOB notify Utilities of the air-low condition? Was there a standard protocol for such notifications, and was it followed?",
      "rationale": "Unclear communication channels could delay recognition or escalation. Need evidence on notification methods (radio vs phone) and response SLAs.",
      "evidenceNeeded": [
        "Communication log entries",
        "Standard operating procedure for alarm reporting"
      ],
      "priority": "low","sourceIds":[],
      "routedTo":["communication-supervision"]}, {
      "intent": "Verify whether the crew received recent training or briefings on updated system configurations.",
      "text": "Did U-A/U-B review any revised drawings, P&IDs, or change notices before starting work? Is there evidence of a briefing session?",
      "rationale": "Lack of awareness about new equipment states could lead to unexpected interactions. Need confirmation of training records or sign-offs.",
      "evidenceNeeded": [
        "Training attendance sheets",
        "Change notice distribution logs"
      ],
      "priority": "low","sourceIds":[],
      "routedTo":["human"]}, {
      "intent": "Understand why the alarm display retained legacy text ('COMP FAULT') despite mapping to pressure input.",
      "text": "Why was the AL-44 label not updated after equipment changes? Does this mislabeling affect operator response or troubleshooting?",
      "rationale": "Legacy labels can confuse operators during emergencies. Need engineering change order records and UI update logs.",
      "evidenceNeeded": [
        "Engineering change orders for alarm screen",
        "UI configuration history"
      ],
      "priority": "low","sourceIds":[],
      "routedTo":["equipment-tool"]}, {
      "intent": "Determine if environmental factors (noise, distance) impacted communication reliability.",
      "text": "Were there known high-noise zones or long distances between RHOB and Utilities control rooms that could degrade message clarity?",
      "rationale": "Environmental conditions might explain missed alarms or delayed acknowledgments. Need site layout maps and noise level data.",
      "evidenceNeeded": [
        "Site acoustic survey reports",
        "Control room location plans"
      ],
      "priority":"low","sourceIds":[],
      "routedTo":["communication-supervision"]}
  ],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "The focal event is a localized pressure drop at RHOB receiving header (P-R), supported by upstream stability and alarm mapping. Key gaps include unknown failure mechanism, incomplete work documentation (blank WO-527-E), unsigned boundary release signature, and unverified communication protocols. Competing hypotheses: 1) Equipment failure downstream of P-U; 2) Procedural non-compliance due to missing records/signatures; 3) Communication breakdown delaying response. Evidence supports conditions but not direct causes yet.",
    "evidenceUsed": [
      "fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1",
      "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1",
      "da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1"
    ],
    "unknowns": [
      "Exact failure point in RHOB distribution path",
      "Whether blank WO-527-E violated a specific requirement",
      "If unsigned signature indicated procedural breach",
      "Communication method and latency details"
    ],
    "alternatives": [
      "Equipment malfunction vs. human error due to incomplete documentation",
      "Procedural gap in boundary release process vs. equipment failure",
      "Legacy alarm labeling confusion vs. actual pressure drop cause"
    ],"confidence":0.65},"evidenceRequests":[

  ]
}
